Hi there !
I’m Martin, 26 yo and starting a new life in Brisbane as I have a full-time job here. 
I really need a room and from today would be absolutely perfect !!!
I’ll be available for any visit from now and I would love to find a shared flat such as yours. 
I’m really friendy, sociable and easy to live with (also funny but I can not prove it in a single message …). 
I need to precise that cleaning is also very important for me so do not worry about it for our potential life together!
I would love to know more about the possibility ! 
Hope to know more about you ! 
Martin
